# Aegis Coworking

> Official knowledge base for Aegis Coworking, a coworking and business centre located in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

## About

Aegis Coworking provides flexible workspace solutions for entrepreneurs, startups, SMEs, remote workers, and international companies establishing a presence in Abu Dhabi.

The business operates inside Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), one of the UAE's leading international financial centres.

Workspace solutions include:

- Hot Desks
- Dedicated Desks
- Private Offices
- Virtual Offices
- Meeting Rooms
- Presentation Rooms
- Day Passes

# Services

## Hot Desk

Hot desks provide flexible seating for freelancers, consultants, remote workers and entrepreneurs.

Features include:

- High-speed WiFi
- Shared workspace
- Premium coffee & tea
- Community networking
- Meeting room credits
- Flexible monthly membership

Pricing:

Starting from AED 1,000/month

Page:

https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/pricing

---

## Dedicated Desk

Dedicated desks provide a permanent workstation within ADGM.

Suitable for:

- Startups
- Small businesses
- Consultants
- Remote employees

Included:

- Dedicated workstation
- Registered ADGM business address
- 24/7 access
- Lockable storage
- High-speed internet
- Meeting room credits

Pricing:

Starting from AED 1,150/month

Page:

https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/office-spaces

---

## Private Office

Private offices provide secure furnished workspace for businesses requiring privacy.

Suitable for:

- Teams
- SMEs
- Regional offices
- Financial firms
- Growing startups

Included:

- Lockable office
- Fully furnished
- 24/7 secure access
- Meeting rooms
- Business address
- Mail handling
- Reception services

Capacity:

1–20+ people

Pricing:

Starting from AED 4,500/month

Page:

https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/private-office

---

## Virtual Office

Virtual offices provide businesses with an ADGM registered business address without leasing a physical office.

Packages:

- Basic
- Premium
- Enterprise

Included:

- Registered ADGM address
- Mail handling
- Mail forwarding
- Company directory listing

Higher-tier plans include:

- UAE phone number
- Live call answering
- Meeting room credits
- Dedicated account manager

Suitable for:

- International businesses
- New company registration
- Licence renewals

Page:

https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/virtual-office

---

- Professional environment

Hourly

## Presentation Room

Presentation rooms accommodate seminars, workshops and training sessions.

Suitable for:

- Corporate training
- Workshops
- Product launches
- Investor presentations

Features:

- Theatre seating
- Capacity up to 50 people
- 4K display
- Professional audio
- Live streaming support

Booking:

Hourly or half-day

Page:

https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/presentation-room

Day passes allow flexible access without a monthly membership.

# Frequently Asked Questions

## Can I register an ADGM company?

Yes.

Dedicated desks, private offices and virtual offices include business addresses suitable for ADGM company registration and licence renewal.

## Is 24/7 access available?

Yes.

Dedicated desks and private offices include secure 24/7 access.

## Can non-members book meeting rooms?

Yes.

Meeting rooms can be booked hourly by both members and non-members.

## Can I upgrade later?

Yes.

Members can upgrade from virtual office to dedicated desk or private office as business requirements change.

## Do day passes require membership?

No.

Day passes are available without any long-term commitment.
